verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Swell's app development framework: CLI, functions, data models and webhooks. It also mentions one official storefront app (Proxima) and "app-installed" models. These are developer building blocks plus a single first-party app, not a merchant-facing marketplace of vetted third-party apps covering long-tail features. Nothing in the pack shows an app store, a listing catalog or a vetting process.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can extend my store from a marketplace of vetted apps and extensions covering the long tail of features
